items.label: FIGURE O.10
items.title: Additional emissions associated with poverty alleviation increase with the level of ambition
items.content: The chart is an area chart showing additional emissions relative to global 2019 CO2e emissions (%) from 2022 to 2050. The legend includes two categories: $6.85 (represented by the dark blue area) and $2.15 (represented by the orange area). The x-axis represents years from 2022 to 2050. The y-axis represents relative emissions from 0 to 45%. The $2.15 line shows a very small, nearly flat increase over time. The $6.85 area shows a steady, significant growth, reaching approximately 46% by 2050. Source: Wollburg, Hallegatte, and Mahler 2023. Note: CO2e = carbon dioxide equivalent. The figure shows additional emissions relative to 2019 if poverty were to be alleviated at the $2.15 and $6.85 per person per day poverty lines (expressed in 2017 purchasing power parity dollars) using historical emission intensities.
